terms.grammar: verb, second conjugation, with prō and the ablative
evidence: Caes. BG 1.44: sēsē illum nōn prō amīcō, sed prō hoste habitūrum
Cic. Att. 13.1.2: istuc jam prō factō habeō
terms.comment: Prō certō habēre, consider as certain (Cic. Att. 10.6.3, Lewis & Short); in numerō habēre, count among (Lewis & Short).

terms.gloss: reckon, consider (with a genitive of value or a predicate)
evidence: Cic. Fin. 2.24: parvī id dūcēbat (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: think, reckon; value (with a genitive of value)
evidence: Cic. Planc. 11: magnī putāre honōrēs (Lewis & Short)

phrases.english: I consider that as good as done

phrases.latin: sēsē illum nōn prō amīcō, sed prō hoste habitūrum
phrases.english: (he said) he would regard him not as a friend but as an enemy

sources: Lewis & Short: habeo · Lewis & Short: duco · Lewis & Short: puto
